related_questions.question: How to calculate ERTC with PPP?
related_questions.snippet: How do you calculate ERC with PPP? When calculating the Employee Retention Credit (ERC) with a PPP loan, ensure you don't claim ERC for wages used to qualify for PPP forgiveness. Calculate the ERC as 50% of eligible wages per employee, up to $10,000 per quarter, and subtract it from your PPP forgiveness amount.
